title: web2: card effect previews and effects in force
description: web2 (not web/) on a desktop of 1920x1080 and at the width of a Pixel 9 (412x923). A reaction row says under the card name what playing it would do now (the engine's EffectPreview.phrase); a window over a played action card says what that card will do when it resolves (DecisionContext.pending_effect), or still "Not resolved yet." when the engine has no preview of it; the lingering effects in force are chips in the toolbar (GameView.active_effects title, summary, expiry). Shots 1 to 8 are a real game of the engine in the page (the late-game scenario, every seat played here, the wasm build of web2/scripts/build-wasm.sh): nothing is mocked. Shots 9 and 10 add three effects to the engine's active_effects of the next update (War Machine x2, Solar Flare, the Shields Holding / Maneuvering Jets pool), worded as ti4_host::view::effects words them. Regenerate with web2/scripts/build-wasm.sh, then cd web && npm run screenshots -- FJ (the captures start web2's own vite).

shots.group: Reaction rows with the engine's preview
shots.heading: Coup d'Etat over Sol's Leadership (real game)
shots.caption: Sol takes the Leadership strategic action; Sardakk N'orr is asked. The row says: "Cancels Sol's Leadership strategic action: it is not resolved, the card is not exhausted and their turn ends.", above the printed window and text.

shots.heading: Reverse Engineer that would change nothing (real game)
shots.caption: Flank Speed is discarded after it resolved; Sardakk N'orr's Reverse Engineer row says "Flank Speed has no component action. Playing it now would change nothing." The toolbar has the one effect in force: Flank Speed, +1 move for all ships, until the end of this tactical action. On the phone the chip makes the page 424 px wide (see Notes).

shots.group: The played card in a Sabotage window
shots.heading: Sabotage over Coup d'Etat: the pending effect (real game)
shots.caption: Sardakk N'orr played Coup d'Etat; Yin is asked. The Sabotage row says "Cancels Sardakk N'orr's Coup d'Etat. The card stays spent and its effect does not happen."; under the printed Coup d'Etat, the played card's result: "Cancels Sol's Leadership strategic action: it is not resolved, the card is not exhausted and their turn ends." instead of "Not resolved yet.".

shots.heading: Sabotage over Flank Speed: the pending effect (real game)
shots.caption: Hacan applied a drafted tactical action at Mecatol Rex (#18) with Flank Speed; Yin is asked. The played card says "+1 to the move value of each of Hacan's ships during this tactical action.".

shots.heading: Sabotage over Plagiarize: no preview, "Not resolved yet." (real game)
shots.caption: Sol plays Plagiarize, which has no preview in the engine. The Sabotage row still says what Sabotage would do ("Cancels Sol's Plagiarize. ..."); the played card says "Not resolved yet.".

shots.heading: The same window in the private draft (real game)
shots.caption: For comparison: in Hacan's draft the game asks "Play Flank Speed / Decline" as a plain list, with no preview sentence and no printed text (the draft does not use the reaction window). The chip appears in the toolbar once the choice is recorded.

shots.group: Effects in force in the toolbar
shots.heading: One chip, whole on hover (real game)
shots.caption: The chip is cut with "…"; its native title (drawn here, Chrome does not render it into screenshots) is the whole text: "Flank Speed: +1 move for all ships · until the end of this tactical action".

shots.heading: The card's "?" (real game)
shots.caption: The "?" of the chip opened: the printed Flank Speed.

shots.heading: Several effects, one of two stacked cards (engine effects plus three added)
shots.caption: Flank Speed (real) and three added effects: War Machine "+8 production, -1 cost (2 cards)", Solar Flare, and the pool "Shields Holding / Maneuvering Jets" (no card, so no "?"). On the desktop the chips push the reference buttons out of the toolbar and the page wider than the window: the player table is cut at the right. On the phone they wrap to one row each, but the page is 444 px wide.

shots.heading: The stacked War Machine on hover
shots.caption: The whole text of the chip with copies: "War Machine: +8 production, -1 cost (2 cards) · until the end of this tactical action".

notes.title: How the real states are reached
notes.text: ?scenario=late-game&humans=255: the engine deals the late-game hands (Yin: Sabotage; Sardakk N'orr: Coup d'Etat, Reverse Engineer; Hacan: Flank Speed), and the page shows each seat that the game asks. The capture clicks through the page as a player does; web2.ts only listens to the Worker's messages (and, for shots 9 and 10, appends to active_effects).

notes.title: Phone: the chips are wider than the screen
notes.text: A chip has max-w-[420px], more than a 412 px phone: with Flank Speed alone the page is 424 px wide, with four chips 444 px; the chips' "?", the toolbar's menu and the step sheet are cut at the right.

notes.title: Desktop: many chips push the toolbar off the screen
notes.text: With four chips the toolbar does not shrink them enough: the round/phase is cut, Objectives ... Dev are pushed out of view, and the page (the player table) is wider than 1920 px.
